name: @typedstandards/cli
description: Sign, withdraw, build a commitment view for, and verify Typed Standards records from the command line, through @typedstandards/produce-core and @typedstandards/verify-core. JSON in, JSON out; the signing seed comes from one environment variable.
author: Nathan Storey

scripts.prebuild: npm run build --workspace @typedstandards/verify-core && npm run build --workspace @typedstandards/produce-core
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
